items.title: Micah Parsons can't believe Christian Watson's catch
items.summary: During the Packers' blowout of the Bears, Christian Watson hauled in a deep 3rd-and-22 bomb from Jordan Love for his second touchdown of the day. FOX cut to the injured Micah Parsons on the sideline wearing a look of total disbelief, and the clip posted by FOX Sports: NFL turned Parsons' face into the reaction meme of the NFL Sunday.
items.author: @NFLonFOX
